name: Child Abuse
overview: The Scriptures affirm the sacredness of children as a heritage from the Lord, emphasizing their value and the responsibility to protect their innocence (Psalms 127:3). God’s law strictly condemns harm done to the unborn and innocent, prescribing punishment for those who cause injury or death (Exodus 21:22; Deuteronomy 27:25). While discipline is necessary and an expression of love (Proverbs 13:24), the Bible also warns against injustice and false accusations that could harm the innocent (Exodus 23:7). These passages collectively underscore the biblical mandate to safeguard children from abuse and to administer loving correction within the boundaries of righteousness.
